description: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One model, served by one vendor-native endpoint: `POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone`. It does not generate text. A caller posts a `state` plus a map of typed questions (Choice / Score / Noul) and gets back one typed decision per question, each with a calibrated probability and a confidence value that application code branches on. `jev-1.13.0` is the versioned API id TypeSafe documents for Jev 1.13, and the catalog id is written verbatim so the router puts an accepted name in the request's `model` field. Input is text only. Context is 64k tokens per request (`state` plus all questions combined) and 32k for `state` plus the single longest question. `outputModalities` reads `text` because the catalog's modality vocabulary has no token for typed structured values; the model emits no free-form string.
